english: The POKéMON LEAGUE is only a short\ndistance after the VICTORY ROAD.\pIf you've come this far, what choice\ndo you have but to keep going?
dutch: De POKéMON LEAGUE is vlak na de\nVICTORY ROAD.\pAls je al zo ver bent, moet je\nwel doorgaan!

english: The long and harrowing VICTORY ROAD…\pIt's like reliving the path one has\ntraveled in life…\pBelieve in your POKéMON and give it\nyour very best!
dutch: De lange, zware VICTORY ROAD…\pHet is als de weg die je in je\nleven hebt gelopen…\pGeloof in je POKéMON en geef\nalles!
